current_date: November 2021 Edition (amended by BNG addendum, February 2024)
current_evidence: planning.data.gov.uk's Reading 'Validation Requirements' entry (entry-date 2026-10-16) points to this November 2021 edition. Searches of reading.gov.uk found only this edition, the older Dec 2016 checklist, and the 'Validation Checklist Addendum BNG February 2024'. The council's how-to-apply page could not be fetched because the shared web-fetch budget ran out.

issues.detail: The Householder rows are wrong. Grokbot lists only BNG, whose own excerpt says 'except householder applications', and Utilities Statement, which the source limits to major and 'other non-householder' developments. It misses the householder table's actual local requirements: CIL form (floor area increase of 100 sqm or more), Biodiversity survey (near high-value ecological areas or where roof works are proposed), Daylight/sunlight study (where neighbouring light is affected), Heritage Statement (heritage asset or conservation area), Tree survey (works within 15m of a tree), Materials details (where they differ from existing), and Parking and waste details (where these change).
issues.evidence: BNG excerpt: 'For all applications, except householder applications'; Utilities: 'for other non-householder developments'; Part 3 item 23: householder works within 15m of a tree

issues.detail: Part 2 of the source has a table for each of 14 application types, but Grokbot marks most of them '(none)' or fills them with misplaced rows. Reserved matters (source: CIL form, plus information a full application needs for the reserved matters). Advertisement consent (lighting details for illuminated signs; photos or photomontages in or near conservation areas and listed buildings). Lawful development certificate (evidence of established use such as photos, statements, invoices and utility bills; CIL form for new dwellings or 100 sqm+). s73 (planning statement explaining the change; CIL form where dwellings or floorspace change). NMA (approved and proposed plans with explanation). Listed building consent shows only 'Lighting', but the source requires a Heritage Statement, Materials details and detailed plans, possibly at 1:50. Discharge of conditions holds Parking, Wind/Microclimate and Vent/Flue rows whose excerpts come from the Full (Major) table immediately above the Discharge of Conditions heading. Change of use - prior approval holds 'Tree Survey' even though the excerpt says tree surveys are required 'apart from change of use'. The real prior approval items (acoustic assessment for offices within 50m of noisy premises, transport, FRA, contamination) are missing.
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'Wind and Microclimate Assessment Buildings greater than 8 storeys ... 12 Validation Requirements for Planning Applications – November 2021 Discharge of Conditions National validation requirements'; Tree survey 'required on all development sites, apart from change of use'

issues.detail: Several Part 3 local items are missing. Item 15, Materials Details: major, minor and householder development visible from the public realm, and LBC. Item 16, Noise & Vibration Impact Assessment: noisy development near sensitive uses, sensitive uses near noise sources, mixed-use schemes, commercial extraction or cooling units near sensitive uses. Item 13, Landscape Principles: major and minor schemes with external space (captured only as a fragment). Item 25, Vehicle (car/cycle) parking and servicing including waste: all non-householder applications, and householder where parking is lost or altered (Grokbot splits this into fragments and puts the main parking row under Discharge of conditions). Item 17, Open Space Statement: within or adjoining open space, or residential of 10+ dwellings (Grokbot captured the heading with no trigger).
issues.evidence: Part 3 items 13, 15, 16, 17, 25; Grokbot Open Space trigger is just 'Open Space Statement When Required'

issues.detail: Several excerpts come from the wrong part of the document. Air Quality Assessment and Transport Assessment both carry the EIA Scoping Opinion sentence. The real triggers are: air quality, sensitive or intensifying uses in or affecting an AQMA; transport, all majors and larger minors that increase transport demand (that text is attached to the Travel Plan row instead). Ecological Survey and Planning Obligations / S106 Heads of Terms carry the table of contents of the BNG addendum ('Item 6 – Ecological Survey & Report ........ 5'). The real ecology trigger is all major applications, protected species, priority habitats or wildlife sites, and bat surveys for demolition or roof works; Heads of Terms applies where a legal agreement is needed for works or contributions. Affordable Housing ('include an affordable housing statement.') omits the trigger: new dwellings or additional residential floorspace, excluding HMOs and conversions. Landscaping ('different to landscaping plans).') and Planning Statement ('either within a Planning Statement or in a covering letter. 4.') are fragments.
issues.evidence: Grokbot Ecology excerpt: 'Item 6 – Ecological Survey & Report ...... 5 Item 11 – Head of Terms Proposal – s106 Legal Agreements ...... 6'

issues.detail: 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' is mislabelled. Its excerpt is the town-centre retail sequential test (main town centre uses; impact assessment over 1,000 sqm under policy RL5), not the flood sequential or exception test. It duplicates the Retail / Town Centre row.
issues.evidence: 'The requirement for a Sequential Test applies to all applications for main town centre uses as defined in the NPPF ... policy RL5 an Impact Assessment is required only for developments that would exceed 1,000 sq m'

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Change of use - prior approval is invented: its excerpt is the tree survey trigger. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is the s106 Heads of Terms sentence, not a pre-app requirement. 'Validation checklist form (completed)' is advisory ('it helps officers to check and validate the application more quickly'), not mandatory. 'Photographs / Photomontages' under Full planning is the Certificate of Lawfulness evidence row ('Photographs – current and historic, Statements from tenants/owners'). 'Character / Conservation area appraisal reference' duplicates the Heritage Statement guidance.
issues.evidence: 'By submitting a completed checklist with an application ... it helps officers to check and validate the application more quickly.'

issues.detail: Most of the 17 tab_items are process or boilerplate text rather than requirements: the pre-submission check for an administrative fee, the invalid-application refund minus admin costs, the 28-day period to supply information, 'single layered PDF', the contents-page text, and the CIL form intro fragment ('for the following types of application:'). The drawing-standard items (no 'do not scale' disclaimers, scale bar, 1:50/1:100 plans) are legitimate drawing standards.
issues.evidence: 'Invalid applications will be closed and the application fee refunded minus a percentage to cover the administration costs'

issues.detail: Most Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning', but the source states application types explicitly in Part 2 tables: Full (Minor) and Full (Major) are separate tables. Outline takes 'the same local requirements as the relevant full application', yet Grokbot lists only Utilities under Outline. Energy Efficiency Statement (item 7), SuDS, Open Space (10+ dwellings) and Wind/Microclimate are Major-only, which the inferred rows do not show. External Lighting is placed only under Listed building consent, but item 9 applies to publicly accessible developments and lighting near homes, listed buildings, conservation areas, wildlife sites, green links or watercourses, for any application type.
issues.evidence: Part 2 Outline table: same local requirements as the relevant full application; Item 7 Energy Efficiency Statement: major applications

issues.detail: The BNG content is out of date in the main row. The Householder BNG excerpt quotes the 2021 text ('DEFRA 3 Metric or its successor'), which the February 2024 BNG addendum supersedes for statutory biodiversity gain. The workbook should cite the addendum as part of the current list. The 'Planning page' field is just the homepage http://www.reading.gov.uk, not the planning 'How to apply' page.
issues.evidence: Docs: 'Validation-Checklist-Addendum-BNG-February-2024.pdf'; 2021 text: 'net gain in biodiversity units as measured using the DEFRA 3 Metric or its successor'

issues.detail: The List date 2021-12-01 is taken from the URL upload month. The document's own text says 'November 2021 Edition' ('Validation Requirements for Planning Applications – November 2021'). The workbook also does not record the February 2024 BNG addendum date.
issues.evidence: Title: 'VALIDATION REQUIREMENTS FOR PLANNING APPLICATIONS November 2021 Edition'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Reading list (November 2021 edition, plus a February 2024 BNG addendum); the date is off by a month and the basis is the URL. The application-type mapping is badly wrong: householder rows are contradicted by their own triggers, the 14 per-type tables in Part 2 are largely ignored, and Major-table items are misfiled under Discharge of conditions. Several triggers come from the contents page or the EIA text, and Materials, Noise and Landscape Principles are missing.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
